name: ENGL 1004
title: Introduction to Academic Writing
description: Development of the reading and writing skills essential to university work.  Students placed in ENGL 1004 must pass the course before electing ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
requirement_description: Students placed in ENGL 1004 must pass the course before electing ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Not open to students who have passed ENGL 1010 or 1011.
